statement: For every admissible bounded-ratio family (r_j,d_j), every g>=1, and every residue a, the lift R_j=a+g r_j, D_j=g d_j is admissible with the same ratio constant, its progression union is exactly a+gU, and its lower and upper logarithmic densities are 1/g times those of U. Hence existence or failure of logarithmic density is equivalent after confinement to one positive-capacity arithmetic cell.
dependency_gaps: Confinement does not prove density existence or produce a counterexample.
The earlier binary Erdos embedding also requires odd moduli; the affine lift preserves rather than repairs parity.
Closing the theorem route still requires a quantitative affine-chart inverse decomposition with a summable remainder.
